name: pbiplint
description: Lint Power BI projects (TMDL and PBIR) on your machine. Nothing is uploaded.
long_description: Read-only tools for Claude Desktop: lint a Power BI project folder on this computer, explain a rule, and list the rules. The bundle carries pbiplint's command line itself and runs on Claude Desktop's own Node, so it downloads nothing and makes no network request.

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Lint a Power BI project on this machine and return its findings

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: A rule's guidance: why it matters and how to fix it

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: Every rule pbiplint runs, with its severity
